steps.evidence: Caption: "Start by prying up on this bottom panel" - hands pry long black vented strip from bottom edge and lift it free, showing tabs.
Caption: "remove these 2 screws" - close-up of rear bottom edge shows two screws; blue screwdriver removes both.
Caption: "slide the whole cover to the right" - hands slide black outer cover sideways and lift off, exposing internals.
Caption: "there's the GPU and CPU!" - top-down view shows silver blower and black MSI fan; hands rotate chassis to look before touching.
Captions: "there are 3 screws in these locations" + "the 3rd being under the motherboard" + "right here!" with red arrow on screwdriver pointing to motherboard screw near WiFi/M.2 area.
Captions: "the next step is to remove these screws" + "note! these ones are different from the others!" - shows removing two screws from silver tabs on rear bottom.
Caption: "remove this clip supporting the GPU next" - close-up of clip beside GPU fan; screwdriver unscrews it. Caption: "also different screws!"
Caption: "you can now pull the clip out of the way" - hand pulls small black plastic clip free from chassis.
Caption: "make sure to remove the supporting bracket screws over here as well" - rear IO side with DVI/HDMI shown; screwdriver removes bracket screws at connector end.
Caption: "make sure to remove this cable here" - screwdriver lifts thin black wire from WiFi card on motherboard.
Captions: "you can now gently pull both sides apart" + "the back cover is off!" - hands separate chassis halves and lift silver perforated metal back cover away.
Caption: "Next, remove the GPU power cable" - hand pulls black cable from side of GPU.
Caption: "you can now apply even pressure to remove the GPU from its slot" - hands lift dusty MSI AERO card straight up, gold fingers visible.
Caption: "make sure to remove this cable from here! we will need it later on" - hand detaches small black power adapter cable from back of removed old GPU.

No frame shows seating a replacement card. After GPU removal video pivots to M.2 SSD, T-FORCE VULCAN Z 2.5" unboxing, storage tray removal and SSD mounting. Opening hands-holding-card shots are over table, not insertion. Narration only: "[frame 4542-4566] Nice."
steps.suggested_fix: Remove step - video never shows placing a replacement GPU into the slot.
